answer: The karst register is checked at draw time, gale lists the eligible set, and saffron seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 81 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 81 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone burns for every seat it wants. A farm of 294 pays that 271 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
